capabilities: Look up selected or typed words in Wiktionary or installed offline dictionary packs
Create vocabulary notes from editable templates using dictionary values
Study vocabulary as flashcards with deck management and review intervals
Upgrade legacy flashcards and export decks to Anki, CSV, or JSON
Translate selected text and read text aloud via optional local services
extras: Translation and TTS require separately installed local servers; offline dictionary packs are downloaded separately, checksum-verified, and carry third-party licenses (CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0, GFDL 1.3). The README states there is no telemetry or account system and that Anki export is file-based only, with no AnkiWeb connection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary lookup or vocabulary-note workflow, so learners must leave the app and assemble definitions and flashcards manually.

relations.evidence: Mynary uses Wiktionary by default and can also use optional local dictionary packs
In Anki, choose File → Import, select the exported .txt file
Translation uses a locally running MTranServer.
Local Supertonic server sends speech text to the endpoint you configure
Dictionary data comes from Wiktionary extracts supplied by Kaikki.org.

summary: Dictionary plugin that looks up words via Wiktionary or offline packs, saves vocabulary notes from templates, and studies them as flashcards.
